strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
We're here, Dangel! Warukimedes!
What kinda place is this? It's plain creepy!
Demon Mask Castle... It lives up to its name...
Welcome! ...is what I'd like to say, but where are the others!
We're more'n enough to handle the likes of you.
That's right.
Hoh, they certainly look down on us.
Threatening us with missiles... you dirty rats!
Even without that, we'd take ya on any time!
We don't have time for this.
Grrrr, you mock us! Brother, this isn't the plan, but...
...I'm crushing these guys!
Indeed. The hated Combattler V has blundered right in.
If we can just dispose of them...
the Earthlings' forces will weaken, and Lady Janera will be pleased!
Now, Combattler V! No, Hyoma Aoi! I'll show you!
Bring it! I'll beat some sense into a rotten bastard like you!
Grrr, every word out of his mouth makes my blood boil!
Dangel! Don't fall for petty provocations!
Shut up, Brother.
Hmph, a foolish little brother is such a burden.
...Very well, I'll make you regret coming alone!
Regret, my foot!
Just you guys against Combattler!? Don't make me laugh!
Dangel, now.
Go, my Magma Beasts! Make a bloody example of these cheeky Earthlings!
Just as we figured.
They're so predictable.
And the numbers... is this all?
Your ambush is way too obvious! Quit your yapping!
You're just gonna sit up there and watch!?
Just as calculated.
You've got some nerve...!
Dangel! I told you not to rise to the bait!
Just as calculated, you say? But are your calculations correct?
Fuhahahahaha...
Grr... I never expected them to be this good!
Told ya! We're more than enough on our own!
Let's finish 'em in one go!
...It's time.
Hm... something's off...? Hyoma, be careful!
Heh, it's a bluff. At most they've got more reinforcements hidden, right?
Yeah, yeah. Quit wastin' time and bring 'em out!
Silence! You lot, scatter these fools!
Th-This is...!
No way! Why!?
The Einst... series...!?
Hwahahaha! You seem surprised!
So you finally crawled out!
So what! We've fought these guys more times than I can stand! Now...
Hyoma! Geez, you don't get it at all!
What? Get what!
The Einst series... we don't know what they're after, but
they never teamed up with any other force...!
Exactly! Just now, Dangel... called the Einst series
in as reinforcements!
Fufufufufu... I'd love to crush you with Magma Beasts, but...
I'll leave this to them... Kukuku.
Those Campbellians... they've joined hands with those things!?
The Einst appeared when Garuda and Oleana were around too, right!?
So they were in cahoots from the start!?
Could that be... Huh!? Something on radar... This is!
It seems the breach went well.
So it does. All right, all units... What!?
It can't be...!
Well... we meant to surprise them, but it seems it's the other way around.
Gwahahahaha! Bad timing, Earthlings!
The Campbellians and the Einst series... what's their connection!?
Hey, old man Hazuki! Talk later! We'd better launch, fast!
They're back again!? They just don't quit!
Watch out! These guys... are in cahoots with the Campbellians!
Huh?
So that means...
Are you saying they've... joined forces with another group?
No, Captain, they may have been the Campbellians' pawns all along...
...That can't be...
Kyosuke...?
...Kyosuke Nanbu, Alteisen, launching!
Hm? Anyway, launch! Back up the advance team!
All units, please launch.
(I have a bad feeling... Demon Mask Castle... is there more to this...?)
...Pawns of the Campbellians...? No, that can't be...!
...Old... Ones...
What...!?
Kyosuke, what's wrong!?
Could it be... you heard a voice!? Kyosuke!
(What does that mean? Old Ones...?)
Hm!? That machine!
That red one...!
You...!
Kyosuke...
Excellen... What did you do to Excellen!
What's wrong, Kyosuke!
Don't tell me... this red one is...?
...Answer me. Why did you take Excellen? ...No, that doesn't matter.
Where did you hide her? That's all I need.
But... whether you answer or not, you're getting my stake.
...I am Alchemie...
I heard that before. Besides, I've no interest in your name.
...Where is she?
...Kyosuke... why...? I'm... the same as that woman... and yet... you...
(...What is she saying...? Her goal... no, their goal is beyond me...)
What are you yammering about! Think about the situation!
...Right. We meant to catch them in a pincer, but we're surrounded.
Tch, nothing's going right! In that case...
Same as always, then.
...Kyosuke...
This won't end like always...!
Who you are, and what you did to Excellen... You're going to tell me!
Alchemie, you said...! What do you want!
What do you want from me!? Why did you take Excellen!
...The hour... is coming...
What...!?
Life... in the land of beginnings... a new... For that... it's not enough...
What are you talking about...? Speak plainly!
With that... I might understand this hazy feeling in my chest...
...Person-Lichkeit... I wish you'd held out a little longer...
Running away...!? Wait! You haven't told me anything!
...There's still time. Only a little... though. That woman... is gone too...
I've already met Excellen...!
I don't know what you did to her... but sooner or later, I'll take her back...!
Nanbu! What's wrong!
Finish it off right here!
I'd like to have a meaningful talk... but it seems that won't do...
...I have no such intention.
The hour draws near... That woman and I... are both incomplete.
But when the time comes...
What...?
...Farewell, Kyosuke...
What... was that all about...
Alchemie... what is about to happen...? What... is near...?
Guoooooh!
Gotcha!
At this rate... we can take him down!
If we can take out one of their leaders!
This is the end, Dangel!
Grrr, Hyoma Aoi! Next time will be the end of you and Londo Bell!
Tch, you're running!? After you started this!
Wait!
You didn't have to point missiles at the Nanbara Connection...
I'll take you on any time!
Blast, these infuriating pests...
Are you running away?
A drawn-out battle is to our disadvantage. We withdraw for now!
What the, he ran off!
They weren't much at all.
I'd hoped to finish them off... Hmm...
What a sorry bunch. Setting up a trap like this, then running away.
It just means we're that strong. Isn't that enough, Hyoma?
Still... for some of us, it ain't that simple.
That Aluminum girl or whatever... she's the one who took your girl?
Uh, only the first two letters match, Joe.
Kyosuke... who is she?
...I don't know. But... if I can find the link between her and Excellen...
(And... to me as well.)
Excellen, the Campbellians, the mystery foe... How's it all linked?
...Probably... there's no link between the Campbellians and Excellen.
...It's the Einst series... them.
Why they get in our way, why they side with the enemy...
So much we don't understand.
...If she's the one who took Excellen... then why, as well.
Uh... yeah, that's true.
Demon Mask Castle... may hold something more. We should search it...
Yeah, and you're curious too, aren't you, Kyosuke?
If we had the time. We can't afford it, Koji.
...Let's go. They're not our only enemy.
Are you sure, Nanbu?
Yes. Alchemie... she probably won't come back here.
Nor will Excellen.
All hands... return to the ship.
(The land of beginnings... I've heard that before... Is this the place?
And... something lacking...?)
